  "pros": [
    "Simplified e-commerce setup and management compared to WordPress.",
    "Reliable platform and strong suite of tools for an apparel business.",
    "Scalability and app ecosystem supported their growth over two years."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Perceived higher transaction fees or subscription costs compared to self-hosted solutions.",
    "Some limitations in advanced customization without developer input.",
    "Reliance on third-party apps for specific niche functionalities."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This CEO, running a small apparel and fashion business, likely found Shopify to be a significant upgrade from WordPress, valuing its ease of use and comprehensive e-commerce features. The platform's reliability and scalability allowed them to focus on business growth rather than technical complexities over more than two years. While generally very satisfied, the cost structure and occasional customization limitations might have been minor points of frustration."
